source: can you make a nice pretty aesthetic server to dress up

image_prompt.text: Highly detailed pretty spots built as backdrops for outfit screenshots and posing
A central gathering area sized for a full server of avatars to stand around in without jamming

notes: Preset Dress Up commits to a judging runway and preparation booths; the prompt only said dress up, so the competition framing is an assumption

open_questions.ask: Aesthetic in which direction - pastel and cosy, or sleek and modern?
Is this a dress-up contest with rounds and voting, or just a pretty hangout to change outfits in?

coverage_missing.ask: Is there a contest with rounds, judging and a winner, or is it purely social?
What aesthetic - pastel boutique, Y2K mall, cottagecore?
One room, or a small venue with several areas?

answers.ask: Aesthetic in which direction - pastel and cosy, or sleek and modern?
answers.answer: Pastel and cosy, with a soft, pretty aesthetic.

answers.ask: Is this a dress-up contest with rounds and voting, or just a pretty hangout to change outfits in?
answers.answer: Just a pretty hangout where players can change outfits and dress up together; no contest rounds or voting.
